Conscript armies are normally worse than mercenary armies in battle. But they do one thing very well. They reflect the political opinion of the general public, which prevents a military overthrow of a democratic government. South Korea also has police service as an option for the conscription, which makes the police much nicer than places like America.

That being said, a conscript army also great impacts the economics of a region by removing men from college and the work force. And most countries have forgotten that service grants rights that are earned not given. In the past it was the right to vote. So conscription can greatly penalize men for serving their country.
